name: create_rust_category_totals
description: Builds a CSV category-totals aggregator in a new module, consumed by an existing render function
prompts: src/lib.rs declares `pub mod aggregate;` and a `render` function that calls `aggregate::category_totals(csv)`, but the aggregate module does not exist yet. Create src/aggregate.rs defining `pub fn category_totals(csv: &str) -> Vec<(String, i64)>`. It parses CSV text whose first line is the header `category,amount` and returns, for each category, its summed amount, as (category, total) pairs sorted by category name ascending. Skip any data row whose category is empty/whitespace or whose amount is not a valid integer. A category appearing on multiple rows accumulates. Header-only or empty input returns an empty Vec. Do not modify src/lib.rs.
